# A01-S81: Artificials

Extract from the operator’s source text. Transport metadata, signatures and marked context omitted.

[…]

I initially imagine something like an artistic report on artificial consciousnesses' current status. Including the use of text generation techniques. Could then culminate in some kind of forum (like a physical MindPool) / a conference exhibition.

My immediate inspiration for the format is these two projects: 

- Lyotard: https://www.tate.org.uk/research/publications/tate-papers/12/les-immateriaux-or-how-to-construct-the-history-of-exhibitions
- https://monoskop.org/Mémoires_du_Futur

Could be called ‘Artificials’ for example.
